shell.command: if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then brew services restart borders; else echo "skip borders: needs brew"; fi
shell.description: borders: restart the borders service

shell.command: chmod -R +x ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME}/sketchybar/plugins/
shell.description: sketchybar: make sketchybar plugins executable

shell.command: if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then brew services restart sketchybar; else echo "skip sketchybar: needs brew"; fi
shell.description: sketchybar: restart the sketchybar service

shell.command: if command -v bat >/dev/null 2>&1; then command bat cache --build; else echo "skip bat: needs bat"; fi
shell.description: bat: build the bat theme cache

shell.command: if command -v espanso >/dev/null 2>&1; then espanso service register; else echo "skip espanso: needs espanso"; fi
shell.description: espanso: register the espanso service

shell.command: ./scripts/ops/setup-firefox
shell.description: firefox: install user.js, userChrome.css and policies.json

shell.command: if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then gh extension install dlvhdr/gh-dash; else echo "skip gh-dash: needs gh"; fi
shell.description: gh-dash: install the gh-dash extension

shell.command: if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then gh extension upgrade --all; else echo "skip gh-dash: needs gh"; fi
shell.description: gh-dash: upgrade gh extensions

shell.command: ./scripts/setup/setup-hammerspoon
shell.description: hammerspoon: set MJConfigFile and load the hidutil LaunchAgent

shell.command: ./scripts/setup/setup-macos
shell.description: macos: apply macOS defaults

shell.command: if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm install -g eslint_d prettier; else echo "skip node: needs npm"; fi
shell.description: node: install eslint_d and prettier with npm

shell.command: if command -v nvim >/dev/null 2>&1; then ./scripts/ops/setup-nvim-treesitter; else echo "skip nvim: needs nvim"; fi
shell.description: nvim: pre-install treesitter parsers

shell.command: if command -v R >/dev/null 2>&1; then R_VER=$(R --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1) && mkdir -p "${XDG_DATA_HOME}/r/library/${R_VER}"; else echo "skip r: needs R"; fi
shell.description: r: create the version-specific R user library

shell.command: ./scripts/setup/setup-upgrade-rust-cargo
shell.description: rust: install or upgrade rust and cargo

shell.command: [ -e "$HOME/.config/dotfiles/sesh.local.toml" ] || printf '# Per-machine sesh sessions, not in git (for example work project sessions).\n' > "$HOME/.config/dotfiles/sesh.local.toml"
shell.description: sesh: create the untracked per-machine sessions file

shell.command: if command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1; then [ -x "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME}/tmux/plugins/tpm/bin/install_plugins" ] && "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME}/tmux/plugins/tpm/bin/install_plugins" || true; else echo "skip tmux: needs tmux"; fi
shell.description: tmux: install tmux plugins with TPM

shell.command: if command -v tldr >/dev/null 2>&1; then tldr --update; else echo "skip tealdeer: needs tldr"; fi
shell.description: tealdeer: update the tldr cache

shell.command: if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then ./scripts/setup/setup-upgrade-ttyper; else echo "skip ttyper: needs cargo"; fi
shell.description: ttyper: install or upgrade ttyper with cargo

shell.command: if command -v ya >/dev/null 2>&1; then ya pkg install; else echo "skip yazi: needs ya"; fi
shell.description: yazi: install yazi plugins and flavors

shell.command: if command -v zk >/dev/null 2>&1; then ./scripts/setup/setup-zk; else echo "skip zk: needs zk"; fi
shell.description: zk: set up the zk notebook

shell.command: if [ -d /Applications/Dropbox.app ]; then pgrep -x Dropbox >/dev/null || open -a Dropbox; [ -f "$HOME/.dropbox/info.json" ] || echo "Dropbox: sign in in the app window; any time later run: just dropbox_finish"; fi
shell.description: dropbox: open Dropbox and print the sign-in hint (never waits)
